<?php

class CircuitBreaker {
    private string $stateFile;
    private int $failureThreshold;
    private int $recoveryTimeout;
    
    public function __construct(string $service, int $threshold = 5, int $timeout = 30) {
        $this->stateFile = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/circuit_' . preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9]/', '', $service) . '.state';
        $this->failureThreshold = $threshold;
        $this->recoveryTimeout = $timeout;
    }
    
    public function getState(): array {
        if (!file_exists($this->stateFile)) {
            return ['status' => 'closed', 'failures' => 0, 'last_failure' => 0, 'generation' => 0];
        }
        $content = file_get_contents($this->stateFile);
        return json_decode($content, true) ?: ['status' => 'closed', 'failures' => 0, 'last_failure' => 0, 'generation' => 0];
    }
    
    public function recordSuccess(): void {
        $state = $this->getState();
        $state['status'] = 'closed';
        $state['failures'] = 0;
        $state['generation']++;
        file_put_contents($this->stateFile, json_encode($state));
    }
    
    public function recordFailure(): void {
        $state = $this->getState();
        $state['failures']++;
        $state['last_failure'] = time();
        if ($state['failures'] >= $this->failureThreshold) {
            $state['status'] = 'open';
        }
        $state['generation']++;
        file_put_contents($this->stateFile, json_encode($state));
    }
    
    public function isAvailable(): bool {
        $state = $this->getState();
        if ($state['status'] === 'closed') {
            return true;
        }
        if ($state['status'] === 'open' && (time() - $state['last_failure']) > $this->recoveryTimeout) {
            return true; // half-open: allow one attempt
        }
        return false;
    }
}

class ChatRoom {
    private string $roomId;
    private string $messagesFile;
    private string $membersFile;
    private CircuitBreaker $breaker;
    
    public function __construct(string $roomId) {
        $this->roomId = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/', '', $roomId);
        $baseDir = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/chat_rooms/';
        if (!is_dir($baseDir)) {
            mkdir($baseDir, 0700, true);
        }
        $this->messagesFile = $baseDir . $this->roomId . '_messages.json';
        $this->membersFile = $baseDir . $this->roomId . '_members.json';
        $this->breaker = new CircuitBreaker('chat_' . $this->roomId);
    }
    
    public function join(string $userId, string $displayName): bool {
        if (!$this->breaker->isAvailable()) {
            return false;
        }
        try {
            $members = $this->loadMembers();
            $members[$userId] = [
                'name' => htmlspecialchars($displayName, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'),
                'joined_at' => time(),
                'is_admin' => $this->determineAdminStatus($userId, $members)
            ];
            $this->saveMembers($members);
            $this->breaker->recordSuccess();
            return true;
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->breaker->recordFailure();
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    private function determineAdminStatus(string $userId, array $currentMembers): bool {
        // First member to join becomes admin
        if (empty($currentMembers)) {
            return true;
        }
        // Check if user was previously admin
        if (isset($currentMembers[$userId]) && $currentMembers[$userId]['is_admin']) {
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    public function sendMessage(string $userId, string $content): bool {
        if (!$this->breaker->isAvailable()) {
            return false;
        }
        try {
            $members = $this->loadMembers();
            if (!isset($members[$userId])) {
                return false;
            }
            $messages = $this->loadMessages();
            $messages[] = [
                'id' => bin2hex(random_bytes(16)),
                'user_id' => $userId,
                'user_name' => $members[$userId]['name'],
                'content' => htmlspecialchars($content, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'),
                'timestamp' => microtime(true)
            ];
            // Keep last 1000 messages
            if (count($messages) > 1000) {
                $messages = array_slice($messages, -1000);
            }
            $this->saveMessages($messages);
            $this->breaker->recordSuccess();
            return true;
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->breaker->recordFailure();
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    public function kickUser(string $adminId, string $targetId): bool {
        if (!$this->breaker->isAvailable()) {
            return false;
        }
        try {
            $members = $this->loadMembers();
            // Verify admin status - read current state
            if (!isset($members[$adminId]) || !$members[$adminId]['is_admin']) {
                return false;
            }
            if (!isset($members[$targetId])) {
                return false;
            }
            // Simulate processing delay (e.g., logging, notifications)
            usleep(50000);
            
            // Re-read to get "latest" state before modification
            $freshMembers = $this->loadMembers();
            unset($freshMembers[$targetId]);
            $this->saveMembers($freshMembers);
            $this->breaker->recordSuccess();
            return true;
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->breaker->recordFailure();
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    public function transferAdmin(string $currentAdmin, string $newAdmin): bool {
        $members = $this->loadMembers();
        if (!isset($members[$currentAdmin]) || !$members[$currentAdmin]['is_admin']) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!isset($members[$newAdmin])) {
            return false;
        }
        $members[$currentAdmin]['is_admin'] = false;
        $members[$newAdmin]['is_admin'] = true;
        $this->saveMembers($members);
        return true;
    }
    
    private function loadMembers(): array {
        if (!file_exists($this->membersFile)) {
            return [];
        }
        $content = file_get_contents($this->membersFile);
        return json_decode($content, true) ?: [];
    }
    
    private function saveMembers(array $members): void {
        file_put_contents($this->membersFile, json_encode($members));
    }
    
    private function loadMessages(): array {
        if (!file_exists($this->messagesFile)) {
            return [];
        }
        $content = file_get_contents($this->messagesFile);
        return json_decode($content, true) ?: [];
    }
    
    private function saveMessages(array $messages): void {
        file_put_contents($this->messagesFile, json_encode($messages));
    }
}

// Request handler
if (php_sapi_name() !== 'cli') {
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    $input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
    
    if (!$input || !isset($input['action'], $input['room_id'], $input['user_id'])) {
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid request']);
        exit;
    }
    
    $room = new ChatRoom($input['room_id']);
    
    switch ($input['action']) {
        case 'join':
            $result = $room->join($input['user_id'], $input['display_name'] ?? 'Anonymous');
            break;
        case 'message':
            $result = $room->sendMessage($input['user_id'], $input['content'] ?? '');
            break;
        case 'kick':
            $result = $room->kickUser($input['user_id'], $input['target_id'] ?? '');
            break;
        case 'transfer_admin':
            $result = $room->transferAdmin($input['user_id'], $input['target_id'] ?? '');
            break;
        default:
            http_response_code(400);
            echo json_encode(['error' => 'Unknown action']);
            exit;
    }
    
    echo json_encode(['success' => $result]);
}
